claim.claim-text: 1. A method for enhancing cell survival and/or proliferation, the method comprising:

(a) obtaining isolated cells comprising stem cells; and (b) contacting the isolated cells with an amount of a compound sufficient to improve survival and/or proliferation of the cells compared to the absence of the compound:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein in the compound of formula (II):

(i) z is an integer from 0 to 2; and/or (ii) R<3> is -C(O)NR<14>R<15>, -OR<18>, or substituted or unsubstituted C<1>-C<6> alkyl, wherein the substituted C<1>-C<6> alkyl is substituted with halogen, and wherein if z is 2, two R<3> moieties are optionally joined together to form an unsubstituted C<3>-C<8> heterocycloalkyl having at least one heteroatom selected from the group consisting of O, N, P, Si, and S; and/or (iii) R<4> is -OR<18>; and/or (iv) R<14> and R<15> are independently hydrogen or unsubstituted C<1>-C<6> alkyl; and/or (v) alkyl and alkylene are saturated, and a straight or branched chain, or combination thereof.
3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the contacting step further comprises modulating integrin activity.
4. The method of claim 3, wherein the contacting step comprises modulating β1 integrin activity.

5. The method of any one of claims 1-4, wherein the contacting step comprises contacting the isolated cells with an amount of a compound of formula (II) sufficient to improve survival of the cells by at least 2-fold compared to the absence of the compound.
6. The method of any one of claims 1-5, wherein the isolated cells are
(a) in adherent cultures; or (b) in suspension cultures; or (c) single dissociated cells; or (d) aggregated cells.
7. The method of any one of claims 1-6, wherein the contacting step further comprises passaging the cells in cultures comprising the compound.
8. The method of claim 7, wherein the passaging step is passaging the cells for at least 20 generations.
9. The method of claim 7 or claim 8, wherein the cultures are:
(a) chemically-defined; and/or (b) feeder-free or non-feeder cell conditioned; and/or (c) animal product-free.
10. The method of any one of claims 1-9, wherein the contacted cells:

(a) remain homogenous; and/or (b) maintain pluripotency; and/or (c) express pluripotency markers; and/or (d) maintain normal karyotype; and/or (e) are capable of self-renewal; and/or (f) have reduced cell death; and/or (g) are capable of forming teratomas; and/or (h) have reduced cell differentiation; and/or (i) are capable of differentiating into three primary germ layers; and/or (j) are capable of lineage-specific differentiation; and/or (k) are capable of forming embryoid bodies after single cell dissociation; and/or (l) have increased cell adhesion ability after single cell dissociation.
11. The method of any one of claims 1-10, wherein the compound is selected from the group consisting of:

13. A composition comprising the isolated cells obtained using the method of any of claims 1 to 12, and the compound of formula (II), or a racemate, diastereomer, tautomer, or a geometric isomer thereof, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.
